A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 22-page versions of the same I2E paper. The text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices can be reliably matched, including the image-based appendix examples.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark comparisons, a 30-participant human evaluation, component ablations, and additional qualitative results in the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark measurements, human-evaluation results, ablations, and appendix examples reported in v1.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same Decomposer, DAG-based spatial constraint propagation, physics-aware VLA Editor, atomic actions, and incremental editing procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate I2E-Bench, MagicBrush, and EmuEdit with the same image-editing task coverage. The benchmark examples and additional scenarios in the appendices are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain IP2P, OmniGen, Step1X, IEAP, and ICEdit. Figure 5 also retains the same commercial-model comparisons; no comparator is added, removed, or replaced.

E3.justification: Both retain the single-refinement-round comparison, 100 sampled image–instruction pairs per benchmark in Appendix A.6, and the same metrics. The human study still uses 30 participants, each rating 10 cases on a 0–10 scale.

E4.justification: The five component ablations in Table 4 and Figure 6 are unchanged, as is the four-round stability analysis in Figure 3. No robustness, sensitivity, or case analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix A.6 retains the same fixed-random-seed statement. Repeated-run information and uncertainty reporting are unchanged; v2 introduces no confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative examples match throughout both PDFs. For example, I2E's I2E-Bench MS remains 0.8074 in Table 1, and its human-evaluation average remains 7.42 in Table 3.

T1.justification: Theorem A.1, Proposition A.2, Observation A.3, and their mathematical arguments are unchanged. The environment formulation, Algorithm 1, and evaluation-metric definitions also remain identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same Decompose-then-Action contribution, I2E-Bench contribution, and claims concerning compositional editing, physical consistency, and multi-turn stability.

C2.justification: The benchmark and ablation interpretations are unchanged. The Limitations section retains the same qualifications concerning complex occlusions, transparent objects, material deformation, fluid dynamics, and lighting interactions.

D1.justification: Appendix A.4 retains the same implementation components and full reasoning/planning prompts, and Appendix A.10 retains the training-free description. The code-and-dataset project-page link also has the same target.

R1.justification: Section 2's research positioning and the complete bibliography are unchanged. Reference entries that move between pages 10 and 11 reflect reflow after the added acknowledgment, not citation additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 revises author order, affiliations, contact information, and contribution notes, including an internship disclosure. It adds an Acknowledgments section naming NSFC and CCF-Kuaishou funding; the scientific prose and organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds a small robot icon beside the title, adjusts the author block and spacing, and reflows references around the new acknowledgment. Research figures, tables, and appendix layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The funding acknowledgment and revised author information add administrative clarity, but the scientific exposition, theory, experiments, results, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged. These limited disclosure and layout edits do not establish a meaningful net change in overall paper quality.
